title: 'Funflation' is on the rise as hobbies get pricier, but consumers keep spending anyway
summary_full: Consumers are spending more on hobbies like arts and crafts and outdoor sports, as it gets more expensive to travel due to increased airfare.
summary_public: Consumers are spending more on hobbies like arts and crafts and outdoor sports, as it gets more expensive to travel due to increased airfare.
